definition: Official rushing yards, kneel-downs included. Official nflverse box-score total.
Official rushing touchdowns. Official nflverse box-score total.
Official rush attempts. Official nflverse box-score total.

His share of all his team's official carries in the games he played — every position, quarterback scrambles and kneel-downs included (the usage layer's definition). Pooled over the games he played: his total divided by his team's total in those games, keyed by the club he played for that week.
His share of his team's offensive snaps in the games he played, pooled over snaps. Team snaps are taken from the player on the field for the most snaps.
Carries that gained 10 or more yards.
Expected points added per carry, kneel-downs and two-point tries excluded. Counts first downs, touchdowns and fumbles, not just yards.
Official rushing yards per official carry.
Share of his carries with positive expected points added (EPA > 0).
Share of his carries that gained 10 or more yards.
Average rushing yards above what Next Gen Stats' tracking model expected from each carry's blockers and defenders, from its regular-season summary.
Official receiving touchdowns. Official nflverse box-score total.
Official receptions. Official nflverse box-score total.
Receptions per target — not his share of the team's catches. Uncatchable throws count as targets.
Official receiving yards per target.
Official targets: passes thrown to him. Official nflverse box-score total.
Official receiving yards. Official nflverse box-score total.

His share of his team's targets in the games he played (the usage layer's definition). Pooled over the games he played: his total divided by his team's total in those games, keyed by the club he played for that week.
His share of his team's non-kneel carries inside the 5, every position included, in the games he played.
His share of all his team's non-kneel carries inside the 20 — every position, quarterback runs included — in the games he played.
His share of his team's targets inside the 20 in the games he played.

Carries inside the opponent's 5-yard line.

His 40-yard dash time at the NFL Scouting Combine, in the year he tested, ranked among every tester at the same combine position since 2000 with a recorded time (faster ranks first).
A game played is a regular-season week with a weekly stats row or at least one offensive snap (the usage layer's and season actuals' definition).
